子系统拿票换用户信息 46: │ （跳下一个子系统时，重新调 /sso/jump 换新票） │ 建立本地会话 47: ``` 48: 49: --- 50: 51: ## 2. 接口明细 52: 53: 统一响应包裹：`{ code, msg, data }`，`code=200` 成功；业务失败 `code≠200`，`msg` 为中文错误信息可直接提示。 54: 55: ### 2.1 获取图形验证码 56: 57: ``` 58: POST /v3.0/portal/appLogin/captcha 59: 请求体：无 60: ``` 61: 62: 响应 `data`： 63: 64: | 字段 | 类型 | 说明 | 65: |---|---|---| 66: | `uuid` | string | 验证码唯一标识，提交短信接口时回传 | 67: | `img` | 手机号已注册门户用户（主表手机号或任一子系统同步的手机号）。未注册返回"该手机号未注册门户用户"。 89: 90: 短信规则：6 位数字、**5 分钟有效、校验成功即删除**；同一手机号 **60 秒内不可重复发送**。 91: 92: ### 2.3 三重校验登录 93: 94: ``` 95: POST /v3.0/portal/appLogin/login 96: Content-Type: 登录共用失败计数，默认连续失败 5 次锁定 30 分钟（可配置）。 127: 128: ### 2.4 子系统列表 129: 130: ``` 131: POST /v3.0/portal/appLogin/apps 132: Authorization: Bearer <会话token> 133: 请求体：无 134: ``` 135: 136: 响应 `data`：数组，每项： 137: ``` 150: POST /v3.0/portal/sso/jump 151: Authorization: Bearer <会话token> 152: Content-Type: application/json 153: 154: { "appId": "ZSxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx", "token": "<会话token>" } 155: ``` 156: 157: 响应 parts.text:
Now the login page. Key changes:
- Captcha: use new `fetchAppLoginCaptcha` (active always).
- Send SMS: require fresh captcha, call `sendAppLoginSms` (real mode); demo mode keeps fake.
- Submit verify mode: real → `appLoginAction`; demo → direct.
- Remove password-mode captcha gating confusion; password mode is legacy/remote-closed. Actually document is APP triple login only. I'll keep password mode as-is (existing backward compat) but the primary verify flow now uses real APIs.

tool_input.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
import { useAuthStore } from '../../stores/auth'
import { useStatusBar } from '../../composables/useStatusBar'
import { fetchAppLoginCaptcha, sendAppLoginSms } from '../../utils/portalAuth'
import { toastError } from '../../utils/notify'

const { statusBarStyle } = useStatusBar()
const isRemote = (import.meta.env.VITE_DATA_MODE ?? 'demo') !== 'demo'

/** 登录模式：verify=验证码登录（设计图默认）；password=密码登录 */
const mode = ref<'verify' | 'password'>('verify')

// ===== 验证码登录（设计图默认形态）=====
const phone = ref('')
const idTail = ref('')
const smsCode = ref('')
const smsCountdown = ref(0)
const smsSending = ref(false)
let smsTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null

// ===== 图形验证码（发送短信前必填，一次性、120 秒有效）=====
const captchaCode = ref('')
const captchaUuid = ref('')
const captchaImage = ref('')
const captchaLoading = ref(false)

// ===== 密码登录（旧版兼容）=====
const user = ref('')
const pwd = ref('')
const showPwd = ref(false)

const agreement = ref(false)
const loading = ref(false)

async function refreshCaptcha() {
  // 图形验证码始终请求后端（同源 /api 反代），点击可刷新。
  captchaLoading.value = true
  try {
    const payload = await fetchAppLoginCaptcha()
    captchaUuid.value = payload.uuid
    captchaImage.value = payload.imageDataUrl
    captchaCode.value = ''
  } catch (cause) {
    captchaUuid.value = ''
    captchaImage.value = ''
    toastError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : '验证码加载失败')
  } finally {
    captchaLoading.value = false
  }
}

onMounted(() => { void refreshCaptcha() })

function switchMode() {
  if (loading.value) return
  mode.value = mode.value === 'verify' ? 'password' : 'verify'
}

function startCountdown() {
  smsCountdown.value = 60
  smsTimer = setInterval(() => {
    smsCountdown.value -= 1
    if (smsCountdown.value <= 0 && smsTimer) { clearInterval(smsTimer); smsTimer = null }
  }, 1000)
}

/** 发送短信验证码：先校验图形验证码（一次性，发送前必须 fresh 获取并配对 uuid） */
async function sendSmsCode() {
  if (smsCountdown.value > 0 || smsSending.value) return
  if (!/^1\d{10}$/.test(phone.value.trim())) { toastError('请输入正确的11位手机号码'); return }
  if (!captchaCode.value.trim()) { toastError('请先输入图形验证码'); return }
  if (!captchaUuid.value) { toastError('验证码已失效，请点击图片刷新'); return }
  if (!isRemote) {
    // 演示模式：不请求后端，直接进入倒计时
    startCountdown()
    void refreshCaptcha()
    return
  }
  smsSending.value = true
  try {
    await sendAppLoginSms({
      phone: phone.value.trim(),
      captchaUuid: captchaUuid.value,
      captchaCode: captchaCode.value.trim(),
    })
    uni.showToast({ title: '验证码已发送', icon: 'none', duration: 1800 })
    startCountdown()
  } catch (cause) {
    toastError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : '短信发送失败，请重试')
  } finally {
    // 图形验证码一次性：无论成败都需刷新，uuid 与图片重新配对
    await refreshCaptcha()
    smsSending.value = false
  }
}

async function submit() {
  if (loading.value) return
  if (mode.value === 'verify') {
    if (!/^1\d{10}$/.test(phone.value.trim())) { toastError('请输入正确的11位手机号码'); return }
    if (!/^\d{4}$/.test(idTail.value.trim())) { toastError('请输入身份证号后四位'); return }
    if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(smsCode.value.trim())) { toastError('请输入6位短信验证码'); return }
  } else {
    if (!user.value.trim()) { toastError('请输入账号'); return }
    if (!pwd.value) { toastError('请输入密码'); return }
  }
  if (!agreement.value) { toastError('请勾选同意用户协议和隐私协议'); return }

  loading.value = true
  try {
    if (mode.value === 'verify') {
      if (isRemote) {
        await useAuthStore().appLoginAction({
          phone: phone.value.trim(),
          idNumberSuffix: idTail.value.trim(),
          smsCode: smsCode.value.trim(),
        })
      }
      // 演示模式或真实登录成功后进入子系统选择
      uni.reLaunch({ url: '/pages/systems/index' })
    } else {
      if (isRemote) throw new Error('密码登录接口未开放，请使用验证码登录')
      // 演示模式：直接进入
      uni.reLaunch({ url: '/pages/systems/index' })
    }
  } catch (cause) {
    toastError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : '登录失败，请重试')
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <view class="screen login-screen" :style="statusBarStyle">
    <view class="login-topbar"><text class="login-topbar-title">登录</text></view>

    <view class="login-content">
      <view class="login-brand">
        <view class="login-brand-mark">
          <image class="login-brand-icon" src="/static/assets/092e1.svg" mode="aspectFit" />
        </view>
        <text class="login-brand-name">苏州市服务监管平台</text>
      </view>

      <view class="login-card">
        <!-- 验证码登录（设计图默认形态） -->
        <template v-if="mode === 'verify'">
          <view class="login-field">
            <text class="login-field-label"><text class="login-req">*</text> 手机号码</text>
            <view class="login-input-shell">
              <image class="login-input-icon" src="/static/assets/login-user.svg" mode="aspectFit" />
              <input v-model="phone" type="number" maxlength="11" placeholder="请输入手机号码" :disabled="loading" />
            </view>
          </view>

          <view class="login-field">
            <text class="login-field-label"><text class="login-req">*</text> 身份证号后四位</text>
            <view class="login-input-shell">
              <image class="login-input-icon" src="/static/assets/login-lock.svg" mode="aspectFit" />
              <input v-model="idTail" type="text" maxlength="4" placeholder="请输入身份证号后四位" :disabled="loading" />
            </view>
          </view>

          <view class="login-field">
            <text class="login-field-label"><text class="login-req">*</text> 短信验证码</text>
            <view class="login-input-shell">
              <image class="login-input-icon" src="/static/assets/login-lock.svg" mode="aspectFit" />
              <input v-model="smsCode" type="number" maxlength="6" placeholder="请输入6位短信验证码" :disabled="loading" />
              <text class="login-sms-btn" :class="{ disabled: smsCountdown > 0 || smsSending }" role="button" @click="sendSmsCode">
                {{ smsCountdown > 0 ? `${smsCountdown}s` : (smsSending ? '发送中…' : '获取验证码') }}
              </text>
            </view>
          </view>

          <!-- 图形验证码（发送短信前必填） -->
          <view class="login-field">
            <text class="login-field-label"><text class="login-req">*</text> 图形验证码</text>
            <view class="login-captcha-row">
              <view class="login-input-shell">
                <image class="login-input-icon" src="/static/assets/login-shield.svg" mode="aspectFit" />
                <input v-model="captchaCode" type="text" maxlength="4" placeholder="请输入4位验证码" :disabled="loading || captchaLoading" @confirm="submit" />
              </view>
              <view class="login-captcha-img" role="button" aria-label="刷新验证码" @click="refreshCaptcha">
                <image v-if="captchaImage" class="login-captcha-image" :src="captchaImage" mode="aspectFit" />
                <text v-else class="login-captcha-ph">{{ captchaLoading ? '加载中' : '点击刷新' }}</text>
              </view>
            </view>
          </view>
        </template>

        <!-- 密码登录 -->
        <template v-else>
          <view class="login-field">
            <text class="login-field-label"><text class="login-req">*</text> 账号</text>
            <view class="login-input-shell">
              <image class="login-input-icon" src="/static/assets/login-user.svg" mode="aspectFit" />
              <input v-model="user" type="text" placeholder="请输入账号" :disabled="loading" @confirm="submit" />
            </view>
          </view>

          <view class="login-field">
            <text class="login-field-label"><text class="login-req">*</text> 密码</text>
            <view class="login-input-shell">
              <image class="login-input-icon" src="/static/assets/login-lock.svg" mode="aspectFit" />
              <input v-model="pwd" :password="!showPwd" placeholder="请输入密码" :disabled="loading" @confirm="submit" />
              <image
                class="login-eye"
                :class="{ active: showPwd }"
                src="/static/assets/login-eye-off.svg"
                mode="aspectFit"
                role="button"
                @click="showPwd = !showPwd"
              />
            </view>
          </view>
        </template>

        <view class="login-mode-link" role="button" @click="switchMode">{{ mode === 'verify' ? '密码登录' : '验证码登录' }}</view>

        <view class="login-agreement" role="checkbox" :aria-checked="agreement" @click="agreement = !agreement">
          <view class="login-checkbox" :class="{ checked: agreement }">
            <text v-if="agreement" class="login-check-glyph">✓</text>
          </view>
          <text class="login-agreement-text">请勾选同意用户协议和隐私协议</text>
        </view>

        <view class="login-submit" :class="{ disabled: loading }" role="button" @click="submit">
          <text>{{ loading ? '登录中…' : '登录' }}</text>
        </view>
      </view>
    </view>
  </view>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
import AppHeader from '../../components/AppHeader.vue'
import { useStatusBar } from '../../composables/useStatusBar'
import { useAuthStore } from '../../stores/auth'
import { getToken } from '../../utils/request'
import { fetchPortalApps, jumpToPortalApp, type PortalApp } from '../../utils/portalAuth'
import { toastError } from '../../utils/notify'

const { statusBarStyle } = useStatusBar()
const isRemote = (import.meta.env.VITE_DATA_MODE ?? 'demo') !== 'demo'

interface SystemEntry {
  appId?: string
  title: string
  subtitle: string
  icon: string
  tone: string
  target: string
  authorized: boolean
}

// 演示模式静态数据（真实模式由 /apps 接口返回覆盖）
const demoSystems: SystemEntry[] = [
  { title: '物业管理', subtitle: '项目台账 · 考评监管', icon: '/static/assets/d4dac.svg', tone: 'blue', target: 'workbench', authorized: true },
  { title: '房产交易', subtitle: '网签备案 · 资金核验', icon: '/static/assets/ec0ce.svg', tone: 'orange', target: 'housing', authorized: true },
  { title: '物业手持端', subtitle: '移动工单 · 现场巡检', icon: '/static/assets/25318.svg', tone: 'green', target: 'workbench', authorized: true },
  { title: '其他应用', subtitle: '知识智库 · 信用协同', icon: '/static/assets/bba9d.svg', tone: 'purple', target: 'home', authorized: true },
]

const systems = ref<SystemEntry[]>(isRemote ? [] : demoSystems)
const loading = ref(false)
const jumping = ref(false)

const tonePool = ['blue', 'orange', 'green', 'purple']

function toEntry(app: PortalApp, index: number): SystemEntry {
  return {
    appId: app.appId,
    title: app.appName,
    subtitle: app.authorized ? '点击进入' : '未授权，请联系管理员开通',
    icon: app.appLogo || '/static/assets/d4dac.svg',
    tone: tonePool[index % tonePool.length],
    target: '',
    authorized: Boolean(app.authorized),
  }
}

async function loadApps() {
  if (!isRemote) return
  const token = getToken()
  if (!token) {
    // 会话失效：回到登录页重新走三重校验
    uni.reLaunch({ url: '/pages/login-design/index' })
    return
  }
  loading.value = true
  try {
    const apps = await fetchPortalApps(token)
    systems.value = apps.map(toEntry)
  } catch (cause) {
    const msg = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : ''
    if (msg.includes('登录已失效')) {
      useAuthStore().logout()
      uni.reLaunch({ url: '/pages/login-design/index' })
      return
    }
    toastError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : '子系统加载失败，请重试')
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}

onMounted(() => { void loadApps() })

/** 打开带票跳转地址（App 内用浏览器/WebView 打开；H5 下用新窗口） */
function openRedirect(url: string) {
  // #ifdef H5
  window.location.href = url
  // #endif
  // #ifndef H5
  uni.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/workbench/index?redirect=${encodeURIComponent(url)}` })
  // #endif
}

async function enter(item: SystemEntry) {
  if (jumping.value) return
  if (!item.authorized) {
    toastError('未授权，请联系管理员开通')
    return
  }
  if (isRemote && item.appId) {
    // 真实模式：每次跳转都必须现取新票，禁止缓存 redirectUrl
    const token = getToken()
    if (!token) { uni.reLaunch({ url: '/pages/login-design/index' }); return }
    jumping.value = true
    try {
      const redirectUrl = await jumpToPortalApp(item.appId, token)
      openRedirect(redirectUrl)
    } catch (cause) {
      const msg = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : ''
      if (msg.includes('登录已失效')) {
        useAuthStore().logout()
        uni.reLaunch({ url: '/pages/login-design/index' })
        return
      }
      toastError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : '跳转失败，请重试')
    } finally {
      jumping.value = false
    }
    return
  }
  // 演示模式：进入本地占位页
  if (item.target) uni.reLaunch({ url: `/pages/${item.target}/index` })
}

function back() {
  const pages = getCurrentPages()
  if (pages.length > 1) uni.navigateBack()
  else uni.reLaunch({ url: '/pages/home/index' })
}
</script>

<template>
  <view class="screen systems-screen" :style="statusBarStyle">
    <AppHeader title="" :back="true" @back="back" />
    <view class="system-hero">
      <image class="system-hero-image" src="/static/assets/5b3eb.svg" mode="widthFix" />
      <view class="prompt-dot"><text class="prompt-dot-text">请选择您要进入的业务子系统</text></view>
    </view>

    <view v-if="loading" class="system-loading"><text class="system-loading-text">加载中…</text></view>
    <view v-else-if="systems.length === 0" class="system-loading"><text class="system-loading-text">暂无可用的业务子系统</text></view>

    <view v-else class="system-grid">
      <view
        v-for="item in systems"
        :key="item.appId || item.title"
        class="system-card"
        :class="{ disabled: !item.authorized }"
        role="button"
        @click="enter(item)"
      >
        <view class="round-icon" :class="item.tone">
          <image class="round-icon-image" :src="item.icon" />
        </view>
        <text class="system-card-title">{{ item.title }}</text>
        <text class="system-card-sub">{{ item.subtitle }}</text>
      </view>
    </view>
  </view>
</template>

已按《统一门户 APP 端登录接口文档 v1.0.0》完成对接，`vue-tsc` 类型检查与 `npm run build` 均通过（exit 0）。

## 改动清单

**新增 [`src/utils/portalAuth.ts`](src/utils/portalAuth.ts)** — 5 个接口封装（`/api` 前缀 + `/v3.0`）：
| 接口 | 函数 | 处理要点 |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /portal/appLogin/captcha` | `fetchAppLoginCaptcha` | 解 `{uuid,img}`，`img` 兼容 `data:` 与裸 base64 |
| `POST /portal/appLogin/sms` | `sendAppLoginSms` | 传 `phone/captchaUuid/captchaCode` |
| `POST /portal/appLogin/login` | `appLogin` | 三重校验，`userId` long→字符串 |
| `POST /portal/appLogin/apps` | `fetchPortalApps` | 带 Bearer，返回含 `authorized` |
| `POST /portal/sso/jump` | `jumpToPortalApp` | 每次现取新票，绝不缓存 |
统一解包 `{code,msg,data}`：`code≠200` 抛 `msg`（可直接提示），401 → "登录已失效"。

**改 [`src/stores/auth.ts`](src/stores/auth.ts)** — 新增 `appLoginAction`（登录后存 token + 用户信息到本地），`currentUser`/`logout`/`isLoggedIn`；保留旧密码登录兼容。

**改 [`src/pages/login-design/index.vue`](src/pages/login-design/index.vue)**
- 图形验证码走新接口、常驻展示、点击刷新；
- 发送短信前强制校验图形码，**发送后无论成败都刷新图形码**（一次性、uuid 与图片重新配对）；
- 验证码登录改为真实三重校验（手机号 + 身份证后 4 位 + 6 位短信码），60 秒倒计时；
- demo 模式保留原直进逻辑，真实模式不再走"接口未开放"占位。

**改 [`src/pages/systems/index.vue`](src/pages/systems/index.vue)**
- 真实模式挂载时调 `/apps` 渲染列表；`authorized=false` 置灰并提示"未授权，请联系管理员开通"，不发起跳转；
- 点击已授权项**每次现调 `/sso/jump` 换新票**再打开 `redirectUrl`（红线：不缓存跳转地址）；
- 401 自动登出回登录页；demo 模式保留静态四宫格。

**改 [`src/styles/theme.css`](src/styles/theme.css)** — 补 `.system-card.disabled`、`.system-loading` 样式。

## 说明与待确认
- 接口路径按文档字面拼为 `/api/v3.0/portal/...`（`VITE_API_BASE_URL=/api` + `/v3.0`）。若网关实际 `/v3.0` 已含在代理前缀里，只改 `portalAuth.ts` 的 `portalBase()` 一处即可。
- 仓库声明了 `tools/testing` 工作区与 `playwright` 脚本，但目录和配置实际缺失，故验证以 **typecheck + build** 为准（均通过），未跑单测/E2E。
